enonce.texte:
Match the job interview vocabulary with their correct definitions.

  • CV/Resume – ?
  • Interview – ?
  • Qualifications – ?
  • Skills – ?
  • Experience – ?

questions.texte: Match 'CV/Resume' to its definition.
questions.reponse: A document listing your education and work history.

questions.texte: Match 'Interview' to its definition.
questions.reponse: A formal meeting where you are asked questions about your skills and experience.

questions.texte: Match 'Qualifications' to its definition.
questions.reponse: Certificates or diplomas showing you completed a course or training.

questions.texte: Match 'Skills' to its definition.
questions.reponse: Abilities or talents you have (e.g., speaking English, using computers).

questions.texte: Match 'Experience' to its definition.
questions.reponse: The knowledge or skill you get from doing a job for a period of time.

enonce.texte: Complete the following common interview questions with the correct words.

questions.texte: Can you ______ yourself?
questions.reponse: introduce

questions.texte: Why do you ______ to work for us?
questions.reponse: want

questions.texte: What are your ______ and weaknesses?
questions.reponse: strengths

questions.texte: Where do you ______ yourself in five years?
questions.reponse: see

questions.texte: Why should we ______ you?
questions.reponse: hire

enonce.texte:
Describe your skills and qualifications using the following phrases. Write complete sentences.

  • I have a degree in...
  • I am good at...
  • I can speak...
  • I have experience in...
  • I am proficient in...

questions.texte: Write a sentence using 'I have a degree in...'
questions.reponse: Example: I have a degree in computer science.

questions.texte: Write a sentence using 'I am good at...'
questions.reponse: Example: I am good at working with people.

questions.texte: Write a sentence using 'I can speak...'
questions.reponse: Example: I can speak English and French fluently.

questions.texte: Write a sentence using 'I have experience in...'
questions.reponse: Example: I have experience in customer service.

questions.texte: Write a sentence using 'I am proficient in...'
questions.reponse: Example: I am proficient in Microsoft Office.

enonce.texte:
Prepare answers to the following job interview questions. Write full sentences.

  • Tell me about yourself.
  • Why do you want this job?
  • What are your strengths?
  • What are your weaknesses?
  • Where do you see yourself in five years?
images: A person sitting at an interview table, talking to a panel of interviewers.

questions.texte: Prepare an answer for: 'Tell me about yourself.'
questions.reponse: Example: My name is Marie. I am a recent graduate in business administration. I am hardworking, punctual, and I enjoy working with people.

questions.texte: Prepare an answer for: 'Why do you want this job?'
questions.reponse: Example: I want this job because I am passionate about helping others and I believe this position will allow me to grow professionally.

questions.texte: Prepare an answer for: 'What are your strengths?'
questions.reponse: Example: I am organized, reliable, and I have strong communication skills.

questions.texte: Prepare an answer for: 'What are your weaknesses?'
questions.reponse: Example: I sometimes find it difficult to say no, but I am learning to manage my time better.

questions.texte: Prepare an answer for: 'Where do you see yourself in five years?'
questions.reponse: Example: I see myself in a leadership position, managing a team and contributing to the success of the company.

enonce.texte:
Write a professional self-introduction (5-7 sentences) that you could use in a job interview. Include:

  • Your name and background
  • Your qualifications and skills
  • Your experience
  • Your career goals
images: A person giving a presentation or interview.

questions.texte: Write a professional self-introduction.
questions.reponse: Example: Good morning. My name is Jean. I am a graduate in marketing from the University of Yaoundé. I have excellent communication skills and I am proficient in digital marketing tools. I have experience working as an intern in a marketing agency. I am passionate about creating successful campaigns. My goal is to become a marketing manager in the next five years.

sousQuestions.texte: What is your name and background?
sousQuestions.reponse: Example: My name is Jean. I am a graduate in marketing from the University of Yaoundé.
Example: My goal is to become a marketing manager in the next five years.

enonce.texte:
Analyze the following difficult interview questions and write appropriate answers.

  • What is your biggest weakness?
  • Why did you leave your last job?
  • Tell me about a time you faced a challenge at work.
images: A person thinking during an interview.

questions.texte: What is your biggest weakness?
questions.reponse: Example: I sometimes struggle with public speaking, but I am taking courses to improve my confidence.

questions.texte: Why did you leave your last job?
questions.reponse: Example: I left my last job because I wanted to find a position that offers more opportunities for professional growth.

questions.texte: Tell me about a time you faced a challenge at work.
questions.reponse: Example: In my previous job, we had a very tight deadline for a project. I organized a meeting, divided the tasks among the team, and we completed the project on time.

enonce.texte: Create a dialogue between an interviewer and a candidate. The dialogue should include at least 5 questions and 5 answers. Use the vocabulary and structures from the lesson.
images: Two people at a table, one talking and the other taking notes.

questions.texte: Write a dialogue between an interviewer and a candidate.
questions.reponse: Example: Interviewer: Good morning, please sit down. Can you tell me about yourself? Candidate: Good morning. My name is Sarah. I am a qualified accountant with five years of experience. Interviewer: Why do you want to work for our company? Candidate: I admire your company's reputation for excellence and I would like to contribute to your success. Interviewer: What are your strengths? Candidate: I am very organized and have strong attention to detail. Interviewer: Where do you see yourself in five years? Candidate: I see myself managing a team in the finance department. Interviewer: Thank you for your time. We will contact you soon. Candidate: Thank you for the opportunity.

sousQuestions.texte: What is the first question the interviewer asks?
sousQuestions.reponse: Can you tell me about yourself?
The candidate is very organized and has strong attention to detail.
